welcome.title: New to Zenith?
welcome.body: Take a one-minute tour of the terminal: the chain, the order ticket, confirming a trade and your portfolio. You can skip now and resume any time from the ? menu.
welcome.practiceLabel: Also turn on practice mode (nothing is sent)

steps.title: The options chain
steps.body: Each row is a strike. Calls are on the left, puts on the right, and the shaded rows are in the money. Click an Ask to buy an option, or a Bid to write (sell) one and collect the premium.
steps.missing: The chain lives on the Chain page.

steps.title: The order ticket
steps.body: The ticket shows the payoff at expiry, the Greeks and exactly what the trade costs. Hover or tap any underlined term for a plain-English definition.
steps.missing: Click any Ask or Bid price in the chain to open an order ticket, then press Next.

steps.title: Review and confirm
steps.body: Nothing is sent until you confirm. The confirmation spells the trade out in plain language: what you pay or collect, where you start losing money and the most you can lose. Practice mode lets you try this without sending anything.
steps.missing: Open an order ticket first. The review button is at the bottom of it.

steps.title: Your portfolio
steps.body: Open positions live here, marked to market in real time, with close and roll actions and a whole-portfolio risk view. Closed trades move to History.
steps.missing: Portfolio is in the header navigation.
